newsitem.title: FRANCE: PSA unit buys 17 pct of Bertrand Faure.
newsitem.headline: PSA unit buys 17 pct of Bertrand Faure.

text.p: Car parts manufacturer Ecia, 67 percent controlled by French carmaker PSA Peugeot Citroen, said on Wednesday that it had acquired 17.3 percent of Bertrand Faure and 25.3 percent of Bertrand Faure's voting rights.
Ecia said in a statement that it had acquired the stake by buying 75 percent of Financiere Michel Thierry in a transaction valuing the holding company at 578 million francs.

It said another equipment manufacturer, Treves, had acquired 25 percent of Financiere Michel Thierry, whose primary asset is the 17.3 percent stake in Bertrand Faure, which specialises in making car seats.
